agent_explanation: NS green ends at step 151 and NS yellow runs steps 151-154, but phase is already all-red before EW at step 155, i.e. yellow lasted only 4 s versus required yellow_seconds=6. No events are active, so emergency/ped/fail cannot explain it. The only active special logic is actuated control; with heavy EW queues waiting (~90 s) the controller appears to truncate the NS yellow to serve the recalled direction, violating yellow_duration. Turning actuated off removes the failure.
